name: 1643-library-fault
about: guard-lib-user's after hook on MR::getRandom calls guard-lib's gl.fine (7), then gl.fault, which writes through a null pointer in guard-lib's code. The need walk: guard-lib-user needs guard-lib, so guard-lib-user is off and taken out at the next frame; the log, the mod log and the place name both mods and the place as guard-lib's file+offset; guard-lib stays and is told it was cut (it has no cut: the log says its state may be half done); guard-lib-other's call of gl.fine after it gives 7

expect.log: \[mod guard-lib-user\] GUARD: its call into guard-lib failed \(after hook: MR::getRandom\): a memory access it may not make at guard-lib/[a-z_]+\.[a-z]+\+0x[0-9a-f]+, address 0x[0-9a-f]+\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\. guard-lib stays on\.

\[mod guard-lib\] a fault in guard-lib's code cut gl\.fault short \(at guard-lib/[a-z_]+\.[a-z]+\+0x[0-9a-f]+, called by guard-lib-user\)\. It has no cut, so what that call was changing may be half done; it stays on\.
